rationale.chose: The learner selected option Every acid fully releases its hydrogen ions in water, so every acid is equally strong as their answer to this question.
rationale.reteach: Reteach from the paired notes trap: All acids are strong acids.. The slip: Acid sounds dangerous, so every acid is treated like it fully burns through everything. The fix: Weak acids only partly release their hydrogen ions: vinegar is still acidic, just not strong. rationale.thinks: They are applying the coded wrong turn instead of checking what each part of the working represents.
